name: Levi Deffebach
role: Medora cowman; brother of Rassie Deffebach
bio: Levi Deffebach, a brother of Rassie Deffebach, went to Germany in early 1885 to settle a large estate awaiting the Deffebach heirs and returned in March. That spring he worked the bull round-up, and in May and June 1885 he and J. C. Fisher ran the Cow Boy while the editor was away. In March 1886 he left to work the summer for a Rapid City outfit on Crooked creek.
